'''2006 Corellia Regional''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG regional championship held on 17 June 2006 in the Student Center's HUB at Kent State University, Kent, Ohio, hosted by Team Ohio.<ref name="pcf-9940-136762">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=136762#136762 Road to Worlds 2006], Justin Stratton (Nitsuj), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (15 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617222140/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9940 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-9940-138047">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=138047#138047 Road to Worlds 2006], Justin Stratton (Nitsuj), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617222140/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9940 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Patrick Johnson|Pat Johnson]] and [[Reid Smith]] were co-champions.<ref name="pcf-9443-141803">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141803#141803 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Justin Stratton (Nitsuj), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (17 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618055549/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141112 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Kent State University Student Center (HUB), Kent, Ohio<ref name="pcf-9940-136762" />
* '''Dates:''' 17 June 2006<ref name="pcf-9940-136762" /><ref name="pcf-9940-138047" />
* '''Time:''' pre-registration from 11:00 am; first game at 12:00<ref name="pcf-9940-136762" />
* '''Format:''' three rounds (six games), then a final confrontation for the top two (top four if more than 30 players came); opaque sleeves only; decklists required<ref name="pcf-9940-136762" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $20<ref name="pcf-9940-136762" />
* '''Prizes:''' a virtual card design and $160 for the winner, $55 for the runner-up (amounts guaranteed with 20 players), and sheets, tournament foils and booster packs for all players; "Day 1 Byes" to the first and second finishers<ref name="pcf-9940-136762" />
* '''Co-champions:''' [[Patrick Johnson|Pat Johnson]], [[Reid Smith]]<ref name="pcf-9443-141803" />

== Organization ==

[[Justin Stratton]] announced the event on 15 May 2006, after being granted approval to make the announcement.<ref name="pcf-9940-136762" /> On 22 May he noted the date change to 17 June, made so that players from Indiana could come.<ref name="pcf-9940-138047" />

== Results ==

On 17 June 2006 Stratton posted that Pat Johnson and Reid Smith were co-champions.<ref name="pcf-9443-141803" /> No standings were posted in the topics read.
